purpose: Teach: 糞/ガール/うーむ/じゃぁ/仔/菊/帖/フン

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、試験前に「糞、間に合わない」って言ってたな
lines.en: Riku, you were the one panicking before the exam saying 'Shit, I'm not gonna make it.'
lines.style: Playful accusation with a knowing smirk. Casual, teasing rhythm. Lean into the call-out like she's been waiting to land this.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、新しいガールバンド推してたな、桜
lines.en: You're one to talk — you were the one gushing about that new girl band, Sakura.
lines.style: Quick deflection, light and easy. Half-grin in the voice. Throws it back without heat, testing if she'll bite.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、数学の問題に「うーむ」って唸ってたな
lines.en: Riku, you were groaning 'Uuugh' at every single math problem.
lines.style: Dry, building momentum. Mimics his groan with affectionate mockery. Eyes narrowed, corner of her mouth up.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、「じゃぁ、答え見せろ」って言ってたろ、桜
lines.en: And you were the one begging 'Come on, show me the answers,' Sakura.
lines.style: Wry counter-volley. Slight mock-desperate tone on the request. Steady eye contact, not backing down from the exchange.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、近所で仔猫見つけて喜んでたな
lines.en: Riku, you were the one who found that kitten and couldn't stop grinning about it.
lines.style: Affectionate jab beneath the teasing. Softer attack than before — she's noticed something genuine. Quick, observant delivery.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、文化祭で菊の花輪作ってたな、桜
lines.en: You made those chrysanthemum wreaths for the culture festival, remember? That was you, Sakura.
lines.style: Gentle reset. Quieter than his previous lines. Finding something solid to say back — not a zinger, but true.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、合宿の旅館で八帖の部屋大喜びしてたな
lines.en: Riku, you were absolutely delighted about that huge eight-mat room at the training camp lodge.
lines.style: Pure delight in catching him. Mimics his giddiness with knowing affection. Playful but not mean — she actually liked seeing him happy.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、「フン、勝負はこれからだ」って仰々しく言ってたろ、桜
lines.en: And you were the one making that grand announcement: 'Hmph, the real battle starts now,' Sakura.
lines.style: Final volley — slow and deliberate mimicry of his overblown confidence. Warm underneath the mockery. Eyes gleaming, almost laughing.
